items.html: There are further four aspects in the aspects of face to face, and they are these: first, that she is a complete Partzuf face to face, except that the measure of her stature is from the chest and below of ZA, and her lights of the aspect of the face, which are in the first five Sefirot of ZA, have not yet been drawn to illuminate in her. And the first aspect — that she is also the aspect of a single point included of ten, opposite the Yesod, face to face — there is no place here to explain it, and it was explained elsewhere, in the commentary on the morning prayer, in the blessing of the Patriarchs (Avot).
